verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Cards product directly delivers this story: order intents give agents a fixed allowance with amount, description, and expiration enforced by Visa/Mastercard network rails, merchant-locking is supported, and "the agent never sees the real card number" — exactly a scoped, limited-use credential instead of a raw card number. This is backed by detailed first-party docs on mechanics (minting one-time card numbers, expiry, revocation, merchant restriction) though missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and clearer agent-checkout-specific dispute/chargeback terms.
